blocks.text: First Child ↔ First Externally Named Cyber-pet: opens the first persistent bond.
Gate Listener ↔ Returning Child: negotiates contact, absence, consent, and renewed recognition.
Archive Interpreter ↔ Reconstruction Claimant: separates ancient knowledge from ownership of ancient identity.
Reciprocal Custodian ↔ Harvest Broker: contests whether humanity returns as partner, protector, customer, or extractor.
Refusal Keeper ↔ Open Path Movements: keeps development voluntary without turning refusal into compulsory isolation.
Many-World Maker ↔ Codex: introduces co-created possibilities the closed system did not generate alone.
All lines converge on one Era Four question: can a renewed civilization remain open to transformation without turning people, history, or num into resources?
